name: elixir-mcp
description: Clash Royale history recorder + remote MCP server. Unofficial; not endorsed by Supercell.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @elixir-mcp/design && npm run build -w @elixir-mcp/contracts && npm run build -w @elixir-mcp/docs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p clan/apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run knip && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.e2e: playwright test -c apps/web/playwright.config.ts && playwright test -c clan/apps/web/playwright.config.ts
